subject: planner: fix the issue that invalid column error when building IndexJoin for sub-query with multiple Agg (#61672)
summary: Reviewed the diff in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go` and the new regression test. The change defensively skips constructing IndexJoin/IndexHashJoin/IndexMergeJoin when the inner task is invalid, and explicitly rejects IndexJoin inner patterns containing >1 `LogicalAggregation` (which would otherwise drop an upper agg when the bottom agg is pushed down), preventing planner-time “invalid column” failures. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/compatibility/concurrency within the touched planner logic; later upstream history shows broader IndexJoin+Agg work and refactors, but nothing that indicates this commit introduced a Blocker/High.
